pages.text: 1. $(l)Incision$(): run the scalpel along the line, steady and slow.
3. $(l)Retractor$(): spread the edges slowly — the upper one first.

Then whatever you operate for: remove bullets, suture internal bleeding or an organ, vascular suture, osteosynthesis (drill and plate kit), chest drain, organ removal or transplant.$(br2)Finally $(l)close$() with sutures. An open wound bleeds heavily ($(cfg)300$() ml/min without clamps) and gets infected fast.
With the osteosynthesis kit: the fracture heals $(cfg)3$() times faster.
